decision.summary: A sustained multi-axis trend begins around index 570 (N/E increasing, U decreasing). Between 620–624, U briefly deviates (flattens or rises) while N/E persist upward—consistent with a possible superposed opposing transient, but no full return to pre-transient behavior is observed within allowed context [535,665]. Hence, the interval 570–624 is classified as uncertain; no confirmed temporary offset due to missing opposing return on all axes.

intervals.observation: Sustained monotonic trend in N/E/U from ~570 onward (N/E rising, U falling); near 620–624, U shows a brief flattening/rise while N/E continue upward—suggesting possible superposed opposing transient. Return to original trend direction not observed before end of allowed context (665), and no clear opposing recovery on all axes. Status: uncertain.
